Practices

One page per data collection technique. Each practice page explains what the technique is, how it works, which platforms use it, and how to limit it — across all platforms at once.

  • Off-Platform Activity Tracking CRITICAL
    4 platforms

    When you close the app, the tracking does not stop. How platforms monitor your behavior across the rest of the internet.
  • AI Training Data Usage HIGH
    6 platforms

    Most platforms are using your content to train AI models by default. Opt-outs are forward-looking only.
  • Ad Personalization and Targeting HIGH
    4 platforms

    Turning off personalized ads does not stop data collection. What the toggle most users find actually controls.
  • Third-Party Data Sharing CRITICAL
    5 platforms

    Platforms share your data with companies you have never interacted with. What policy language actually covers.
  • Data Brokers CRITICAL

    Data brokers compile profiles from public records, purchase history, and behavioral data and sell them. Opt-outs are piecemeal and do not cover B2B brokers.

Practice pages cross-link to platform pages and to each other. That's the point — understanding how these techniques work across platforms is more useful than reading about them one at a time.
